title: FAB human body reconstruction code and weights published
summary: Open-source weights and implementation code for the FAB human body reconstruction model are released, providing real-time monocular video extraction of dense surface points and skeletal motion using a distilled ViT-L student network.
research_notes:
Clone the FAB project repository and set up the Python environment with PyTorch and dependencies.

Download the pre-trained ViT-L student model weights from the provided model repository.

Execute the video inference script to extract 3D joint skeletons, dense surface point clouds, and joint contact states from monocular video.

Map predicted joint poses and contact signals to humanoid control targets such as the Unitree G1 robot.

Deploy on a high-throughput GPU such as an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER to maintain real-time reconstruction throughput above thirty-nine frames per second with detection included.

Leverage predicted contact states at the heels, toes, hands, and knees to enforce physical contact constraints and mitigate foot sliding or floor penetration during robotic retargeting.
